title: Stud Vinyl
body:
“Huh... I wonder if this thing will ever work?”

The Stud Vinyl is a record that can be occasionally purchased from the Classic Store for $4,444.

Description


The Stud Vinyl is not always guaranteed to appear in the Classic Store due to the random selection of items.

When inserted into the Blue Vinyl Player and played back, it plays 8-Bit Weapon - M.U.L.E (Bitblaster Mix).

Trivia

  • This is currently the most expensive vinyl in the game.
  • The Stud Vinyl is much larger than any other vinyl.
